SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, KEY_5 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND DOC_NAME='GRDOWN' ORDER BY KEY_3,KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'ILCO' AS BUYER, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, KEY_5 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, 0 AS RO_QTY, 0 AS RO_AMT, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM VIEW_GR, KEPTRXL WHERE KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO(+) AND KEY_2 = LEGACY_PO_SEQ(+) AND KEY_4 = LEGACY_GR_NO(+) AND KEY_5 = LEGACY_GR_SEQ(+) AND DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_5 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2,LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_5 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL
